meta.name: setup
meta.description: Run initial NanoClaw setup. Use when user wants to install NanoClaw, configure it, or go through first-time setup. Triggers on "setup", "install", "configure nanoclaw", or first-time setup requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 完成 NanoClaw 的首次安装与配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接触 NanoClaw 需要初始化设置
copy.tagline_en: Complete initial setup and configuration of NanoClaw
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are new to NanoClaw and need to initialize it

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会指导你在终端运行 `bash nanoclaw.sh` 脚本。这个脚本自动完成依赖、容器镜像、OneCLI 保险库、Anthropic 凭证、服务、首个 agent 等初始配置，失败时还能借助 Claude 从断点恢复。
howto.when: 当你说出“setup”“install”“configure nanoclaw”等，或提出首次安装配置请求时触发。

say.note: Claude 会引导你完成首次设置
Claude 会提示你运行安装脚本

howto.what_en: Claude will instruct you to run `bash nanoclaw.sh`. The script handles the whole initial setup: dependencies, container, OneCLI vault, Anthropic credential, service, first agent, optional channel wiring. If it errors midway, Claude-assisted recovery resumes from the breakpoint.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to install NanoClaw, configure it, or go through first-time setup. Runs on keywords like "setup", "install", "configure nanoclaw", or first-time setup requests.

say_en.note: Claude will tell you to run bash nanoclaw.sh
Claude will start the first-time setup flow

say_en.text: Set up NanoClaw for the first time
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through the install script
